Harley Academy is a Next.js/Prismic CMS platform offering aesthetic medicine (cosmetic dermatology, injectables, Profhilo) training courses for healthcare professionals (doctors, dentists, nurses, pharmacists). The browse-all-aesthetics-courses listing page aggregates courses by specialization. Individual course pages (e.g., /training-courses-for-doctors/, /cosmetic-dermatology-courses/) provide per-course details. JS rendering required to see dynamic session data; platform structure confirmed via sitemap and working course category pages.

records.parked_reason: on-demand e-learning only, no dated events. Radiopaedia.org is a radiology reference and education platform offering self-paced courses and learning modules.
